summary: Returns the length of a string in code units.
description: **Read the caveat before using this.** The name and the original intent are the UTF-8 byte length, but as it stands the function counts UTF-16 code units and only widens the first surrogate it meets. An ASCII string measures correctly; anything outside ASCII — Cyrillic, Greek, CJK, an emoji — measures short. Until that is fixed, measure a payload with `Utilities.newBlob(text).getBytes().length` instead.

throws.InvalidStringException: the value is not a string.
